newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ASTON VILLA SIGN GRAYSON FROM LEICESTER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ASTON VILLA SIGN GRAYSON FROM LEICESTER.

text.p: Brian Little, manager of English premier league Aston Villa, returned to his old club Leicester on Thursday to sign their out of contract defender Simon Grayson.
The fee for the versatile Grayson is likely to be decided by a tribunal, with Leicester valuing Grayson at double the one millions pounds ($602,000) Villa have offered.
